purpose: Robustness, not selection: check whether the blend's result survives neighbouring parameters. The registered forward watch keeps its frozen parameters whatever this shows.
method: vary one dimension at a time around the frozen point (30, 7, 7, 0.25); report the blend, S2 and S3 Sharpe, and max drawdown for every point
robust_if: every neighbour keeps blend Sharpe >= 1.5 and >= S1 trend alone
